cues.zh: 铜箔没有一直延伸到板边，所以我得稍微修整一下。
cues.en: The copper doesn't go right to the edge of the board, so I need to clean it up a little.

cues.zh: 点几滴焊锡把元件固定住
cues.en: Dabs of solder to hold everything in place
...then reflow it and make it neat

cues.zh: 加速度计是后来才加的，需要一些细导线来连接
cues.en: The accelerometer was a late addition and needs some thin wires to connect up

cues.zh: 在模具上涂点凡士林，防止树脂流进 USB 接口
cues.en: Adding some vaseline to the mould, to stop resin getting into the USB port
